claim.claim-text: 1. A puncture mechanism for a beverage machine, comprising:
2. The puncture mechanism of claim 1, wherein:
the first cam comprises a cam path defined in a sidewall of the cam driver; and the first cam follower comprises a carrier ring including a radially-extending pin received in the cam path.
3. The puncture mechanism of claim 2, wherein:

the second cam comprises a cam surface defined by the cam driver; and the second cam follower comprises at least two movable locks that are moved by the cam surface between a first position in which the locks are retracted from the longitudinal axis and a second position in which the locks are extended toward the longitudinal axis.
4. The puncture mechanism of claim 3, wherein the cam surface is defined by a shaft extending through a track defined by the cam follower.
5. A puncture mechanism for a beverage machine, comprising:
6. The puncture mechanism of claim 5, further comprising a rotatable cam driver configured to cause movement of the first cam and the second cam.
7. The puncture mechanism of claim 6, wherein the first cam is defined by the cam driver.
8. The puncture mechanism of claim 7, wherein the first cam comprises a cam path defined by the cam driver.
9. The puncture mechanism of claim 8, wherein the cam path is defined along a circumferential wall and extending axially to define a ramp section along the circumferential wall.

10. The puncture mechanism of claim 9, wherein the cam path further includes a dwell section configured to cause no axial movement of the first cam follower, and the ramp section is configured to cause axial movement of the first cam follower.
11. The puncture mechanism of claim 7, wherein the second cam is defined by the cam driver and wherein the second cam comprises a shaft.
12. The puncture mechanism of claim 11, wherein:
the sliding lock defines the cam follower; and the shaft is arranged within the cam follower.
13. The puncture mechanism of claim 6, further comprising a motor coupled to the cam driver by a gear configured to rotate the cam driver about a longitudinal axis of the puncture mechanism.
14. The puncture mechanism of claim 5, wherein the first cam follower is arranged at a rotationally fixed position about a longitudinal axis of the puncture mechanism.
15. The puncture mechanism of claim 5, wherein the first cam follower comprises a carrier ring including a radially-extending pin that interacts with the first cam path.
